//: Copy to config/config.json and edit. Keep secrets out of this tracked file.

whitelist.//: Chats where Claude may AUTO-SEND replies. Match on the chat's display name.
whitelist.//2: Everything not listed here defaults to hold + escalate.

holdMessage: Thanks — I've seen this and will get back to you shortly.

brain.//: Which decision engine to use. 'stub' needs no API key; 'gemini' works with a free AI Studio key.
brain.//providers: stub | gemini | anthropic | openai (anthropic/openai are seams, not implemented)
brain.//model: For gemini: a current flash-lite model, e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-lite. Check
brain.//apiKeyEnv: Gemini key must be supplied through this environment variable; never hardcode it here.

gui.//: Monitoring dashboard (node src/cli.mjs gui). Binds localhost; publish via a tunnel.
gui.//auth: Optional: if the env var below is set, /api/* requires it as a Bearer token.
gui.//auth2: Leave the env var unset to run open — then auth belongs to the tunnel (Cloudflare Access).

alerts.//: Phone alerts via the alert_phone tool (transport in src/alerts.mjs).
alerts.//notifyAll: When true, EVERY incoming message pushes an alert — no brain in the loop.
alerts.//transport: websocket = POST to the GUI server, which broadcasts to companion apps on
alerts.//transport2: /ws/alerts. fcm = Firebase Cloud Messaging direct to the app.
alerts.//fcm: Needs the service-account JSON (gitignored) and the app's registration token.
alerts.//ignoreAuthors: Messages whose latest author is listed here never alert (e.g. yourself).
alerts.//mentionNames: Name forms used for the addressed-detection backstop: any word-boundary
alerts.//mentionNames2: match fires a phone alert even if the brain didn't (brain is prompted to as well).

debug.//echoLoop: When true, re-respond to whitelisted chats every tick regardless of
debug.//echoLoop2: read state. Lets a self-message loop forever to test the kill switches.
